title: Data Processing Activities Inventory (RoPA)
description: Comprehensive structured inventory mapping personal data flows, processing purposes, legal grounds, storage repositories, processors, and retention periods.
acceptable_examples: Privacy management software export (e.g. OneTrust, TrustArc)
alternative_evidence: Enterprise Data Flow Diagrams (DFDs) paired with systems integration matrices.
verification_procedure: Inspect whether each business unit (HR, IT, Marketing, FinTech) has contributed data flows.
Verify that each activity lists a specific statutory ground (Section 6 Consent or Section 7 clause).
Confirm that personal data categories (Identity, Financial, Device) are itemised.
limitations_and_weaknesses: High-level network topology diagrams that do not identify personal data elements or processing purposes fail this requirement.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Sanitize internal database IP addresses and credentials; ensure no live employee or customer records are present.
retention_considerations: Retain with assessment working papers for statutory audit lifecycle.
reviewer_guidance: Cross-check RoPA entries against the controls evaluated in the assessment to ensure scope completeness.

title: Pre-Consent Itemised Notice Artifacts
description: Verifiable copies and UI screenshots of standalone pre-consent privacy notices presented to Data Principals at collection touchpoints.
acceptable_examples: High-resolution screenshots of live mobile app registration screens
Web signup forms with standalone notice text
alternative_evidence: Staging/UAT environment walk-through video recordings with code commit hash tags.
verification_procedure: Check that notice is presented before or at the time of consent capture.
Verify presence of: (a) itemised personal data list, (b) specified purpose, (c) Section 11 rights description, (d) DPBI complaint procedure, (e) Grievance Officer details.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Submitting a general website footer link to a 20-page legal policy does not satisfy pre-consent notice requirements.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Ensure sample screenshots use dummy/synthetic user inputs (e.g., testuser@example.com).
retention_considerations: Historical screenshots must be version-linked to the corresponding notice revision.
reviewer_guidance: Scrutinize the notice for bundled marketing consent or coercive language.

title: Multilingual Notice Mechanism Proof
description: Proof of technical capability allowing Data Principals to access notice contents in English or any of the 22 Eighth Schedule languages.
acceptable_examples: Screenshots of live language selector toggle displaying regional languages (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, etc.)
Certified translation files integrated into CMS repository
alternative_evidence: API documentation and UI walkthrough of localized CMS delivering regional language content based on browser preference.
verification_procedure: Verify the language toggle provides accessibility across Eighth Schedule languages.
Review sample regional translations to confirm they convey statutory notices accurately.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Relying on unconfigured generic third-party browser translation plugins without native platform support fails Section 5(3).
masking_and_redaction_requirements: None (public UI artifacts).
retention_considerations: Maintain records of certified translations alongside release version numbers.
reviewer_guidance: Test the toggle mechanism in consumer workflows.

title: Legacy User Grandfathering Notice Plan
description: Documented implementation plan and communication artifacts demonstrating delivery of post-enactment notices to data principals whose consent was acquired prior to commencement.
acceptable_examples: Email service provider dispatch telemetry logs (aggregated counts)
Customer portal in-app notice push banners
alternative_evidence: Staged communication rollout schedule approved by legal with pilot cohort delivery proof.
verification_procedure: Inspect notice content for itemised categories, specified purposes, rights, and grievance contact.
Confirm that delivery does not alter underlying service access pending principal review.
Verify delivery tracking telemetry (aggregated counts, delivery success rates).
limitations_and_weaknesses: Merely publishing a notice on a static website without dispatching notice directly to legacy users fails Section 5(2).
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Mask individual recipient email addresses and telephone numbers; use synthetic dispatch samples.
retention_considerations: Retain campaign records for statutory audit and enforcement defense lifecycle.
reviewer_guidance: Verify whether inactive or dormant user accounts are covered by the grandfathering notice campaign or targeted for erasure.

title: Affirmative Consent Capture UI Flow & Logs
description: Visual proof of unbundled, unticked consent UI and technical schema of immutable consent log receipts.
acceptable_examples: UI screenshots showing unticked checkboxes alongside granular purpose toggles
Database schema and sample JSON payload of a consent audit record (with timestamp, notice version, user ID, IP address)
alternative_evidence: Automated Playwright/Cypress end-to-end consent test execution logs.
verification_procedure: Verify that checkboxes are unchecked by default (zero dark patterns).
Confirm that service provision is not conditioned upon consent for optional secondary purposes.
Inspect consent log schema for timestamp, notice version ID, and affirmative action indicator.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Pre-ticked boxes or bundled 'I agree to all' single checkboxes fail Section 6(1).
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Sample database records must use synthetic user IDs (user_synthetic_001) and masked IP addresses (192.0.2.1).
retention_considerations: Consent records must be retained for the life of the processing activity plus statutory limitation periods.
reviewer_guidance: Check whether consent can be proven in an adversarial DPBI dispute.

title: Consent Withdrawal Interface & Workflow
description: Evidence of self-service consent revocation interfaces and backend workflows halting data processing upon withdrawal.
acceptable_examples: Screenshots of user account privacy settings showing 1-click consent toggle off
Backend webhook documentation triggering data de-indexing and processing cessation
alternative_evidence: Video recording of a test user revoking consent in a mobile application with immediate notification receipt.
verification_procedure: Count clicks/actions required to grant consent vs clicks/actions required to revoke.
Verify that withdrawal triggers automated message to downstream processors.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Forcing users to email support or call a contact center to withdraw consent given digitally violates the 'comparable ease' test.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Use test accounts with synthetic profile data.
retention_considerations: Retain withdrawal audit logs for statutory compliance verification.
reviewer_guidance: Test the withdrawal path in standard consumer accounts.

title: Executed Data Processing Agreements (DPA)
description: Redacted copies of legally executed data processing contracts with key IT vendors, cloud hosts, and sub-processors.
acceptable_examples: Fully executed DPA addenda with cloud infrastructure providers (AWS, Azure, GCP)
alternative_evidence: Standard Enterprise Service Agreements containing incorporated data protection schedules.
verification_procedure: Inspect signature blocks for authorized client and vendor execution.
Verify mandatory Rule 7 clauses: processing scope, confidentiality, technical security, breach notice SLA, audit rights, and sub-processor authorization.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Unsigned draft templates or standard clickwrap terms that lack breach notification commitments fail Section 8(2).
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Redact commercial fee schedules and pricing terms. Maintain legal entity names and data protection clauses unredacted.
retention_considerations: Retain for the contract duration plus 3 years.
reviewer_guidance: Ensure all processors identified in RoPA are covered by executed DPAs.

title: Information Security Policy & TOMs Architecture
description: Formal board-approved information security policies detailing Technical and Organisational Measures (TOMs) deployed across enterprise assets.
acceptable_examples: Approved Information Security Management System (ISMS) policy document
alternative_evidence: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Statement of Applicability (SoA) and audit reports.
verification_procedure: Verify executive sign-off and approval date.
Review coverage of access control, vulnerability management, employee offboarding, and physical security.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Unapproved draft policy documents or policies that exist only on paper without technical enforcement fail this control.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Sanitize internal IP schemes, server hostnames, and specific perimeter firewall configurations.
retention_considerations: Maintain current version plus immediate preceding baseline.
reviewer_guidance: Evaluate whether policies specifically address protection of personal data repositories.

title: Cryptographic Architecture & Key Governance
description: Technical architectural specifications documenting encryption at rest, encryption in transit, key lifecycle management, and HSM/KMS configurations.
acceptable_examples: Cloud KMS / HSM key rotation configuration screenshots
TLS 1.3 enforcement policies and cipher suite configurations
alternative_evidence: SOC 2 Type II report detailing Trust Services Criteria CC6.1, CC6.6, and CC6.7 controls.
verification_procedure: Verify algorithm strength (e.g., AES-256 for rest, TLS 1.2/1.3 with PFS for transit).
Inspect automated key rotation schedules (annual or bi-annual).
Confirm segregation of duties between cryptographic key custodians and database administrators.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Hardcoded keys in source code repositories or unrotated static master keys invalidate cryptographic assurance.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Redact master key IDs, secret material, and cloud account credentials. Retain configuration parameters and cipher names.
retention_considerations: Maintain architecture specs for current and immediately preceding baseline.
reviewer_guidance: Verify whether cryptographic protections extend to off-site backups, snapshots, and disaster recovery replication targets.

title: Independent VAPT Audit Executive Summary
description: Executive summary and attestation letter from an independent cybersecurity auditing firm detailing annual VAPT results and vulnerability remediation status.
acceptable_examples: Executive summary of external network and web application penetration test conducted by a CERT-In empaneled or CREST accredited auditor
Remediation verification letter from external security testing firm
alternative_evidence: Comprehensive automated Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST) and infrastructure vulnerability scanning summaries paired with internal security review.
verification_procedure: Check testing scope to ensure personal data applications and databases are covered.
Verify that all critical and high-severity vulnerabilities have been remediated or have documented mitigations.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Self-run automated vulnerability scans with unresolved critical CVEs do not satisfy independent verification.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Redact exploitable proof-of-concept payload strings and sensitive server credentials. Retain vulnerability counts, severity ratings, and auditor sign-off.
retention_considerations: Retain for 3 years to demonstrate continuous security governance.
reviewer_guidance: Check specifically whether database exfiltration and unauthorized API access vulnerabilities were tested.

title: Personal Data Breach Incident Response Plan
description: Formal incident response plan establishing 24/7 detection, escalation, containment, and root-cause analysis for personal data security incidents.
alternative_evidence: Enterprise Cyber Incident Response Plan containing a discrete Personal Data Breach Annex.
verification_procedure: Verify inclusion of specific criteria defining a personal data breach under DPDPA Section 2(u).
Check escalation path to legal, executive management, and DPO.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Generic IT disaster recovery plans that focus solely on system uptime without privacy triage fail this control.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Sanitize personal mobile numbers of crisis team members (retain titles and role designations).
retention_considerations: Maintain active version.
reviewer_guidance: Verify whether the plan distinguishes between standard operational glitches and personal data breaches.

title: Dual Breach Notification Playbook & Templates
description: Pre-drafted statutory breach notification templates and transmission protocols for intimating the Data Protection Board of India and affected Data Principals.
alternative_evidence: Incident ticketing system workflow configured with pre-populated regulatory notification forms.
verification_procedure: Confirm templates contain mandatory statutory details: nature of breach, data categories compromised, potential consequences, mitigation steps, and DPO contact.
Confirm existence of communication channels (bulk email, SMS, postal, portal banner) to reach Data Principals.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Planning to notify only the regulator while having no mechanism to notify individual Data Principals fails Section 8(6).
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Fictional/template placeholder text only.
retention_considerations: Active document.
reviewer_guidance: Check that the notification language is clear, non-technical, and provides actionable mitigation advice to Data Principals.

title: Data Retention Schedule & Automated Purging Proof
description: Enterprise retention schedule defining maximum storage duration per personal data category, supported by automated technical purging configurations.
recommended_freshness: Annual policy review; purging logs within last 3 months
acceptable_examples: Cloud lifecycle rule configuration screenshots (e.g. S3 expiration policies)
alternative_evidence: Third-party certified data destruction certificates paired with quarterly purge review logs.
verification_procedure: Match retention periods against purposes declared in pre-consent notices.
Inspect technical configuration (database triggers, cron jobs) proving automated erasure occurs.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Having a written policy that says 'data will be kept for 3 years' while database records from 8 years ago remain active and unpurged fails Section 8(7).
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Sanitize internal database connection strings.
retention_considerations: Maintain audit records of purged record counts.
reviewer_guidance: Test whether data deletion applies to backups, read-replicas, and development environments.

title: Statutory Retention Exceptions Register
description: Documented register identifying specific statutory enactments requiring retention beyond operational purpose fulfillment, alongside formal legal hold procedures.
acceptable_examples: Cross-statutory retention schedule citing specific Indian enactments (Companies Act 2013 Sec 128, Income-tax Act 1961 Sec 44AA, PMLA 2002 Sec 12)
alternative_evidence: General counsel legal opinion memorandum detailing sector-specific mandatory record retention statutes.
verification_procedure: Verify each listed retention period cites an explicit primary statutory section, not generic business need.
Confirm segregation and restricted access controls for data placed under legal hold.
Verify release workflows triggering immediate erasure once statutory retention expires.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Citing vague operational convenience or undefined tax audit possibility without specific statutory citations fails Section 8(7).
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Redact sensitive litigation matter names or privileged dispute details. Retain statutory citations and category mappings.
retention_considerations: Retain with legal department records.
reviewer_guidance: Cross-check exception register against actual database records flagged for preservation.

title: Data Principal Rights (DSAR) Portal & Logs
description: Operational intake portal, identity verification protocol, and request fulfillment tracking system for processing Data Principal rights.
acceptable_examples: Privacy ticketing portal (e.g. Jira Service Management, Zendesk) configured with DSAR categories
alternative_evidence: Dedicated monitored email intake SOP paired with SLA tracking spreadsheet.
verification_procedure: Test request intake channels across access, correction, erasure, and nomination.
Confirm identity verification procedures do not demand excessive additional personal data.
Verify statutory SLA tracking (resolution within statutory window).
limitations_and_weaknesses: Having an email address listed in a privacy policy without any internal ticketing queue or backend fulfillment mechanism fails Section 11.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Anonymize all applicant names, emails, and ticket details in submitted operational samples.
retention_considerations: Retain DSAR audit records for 3 years to defend against DPBI complaint proceedings.
reviewer_guidance: Verify that erasures approved through DSARs propagate downstream to Data Processors.

title: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Collection
description: Suite of approved departmental standard operating procedures governing day-to-day personal data handling across business units.
acceptable_examples: Approved SOPs for HR data intake
alternative_evidence: Centralized corporate policy portal with mandatory employee acknowledgment and reading completion tracking.
verification_procedure: Confirm documented workflow steps, responsible roles, and escalation thresholds.
Verify evidence of operational distribution and employee access.
limitations_and_weaknesses: High-level abstract policies without step-by-step operational workflows do not qualify as SOPs.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: None beyond internal department codes if proprietary.
retention_considerations: Maintain current active revisions.
reviewer_guidance: Sample check employee adherence through interviews or audit records during on-site reviews.

title: Data Quality & Deduplication SOP
description: Documented standard operating procedures and data validation rules ensuring personal data processed is accurate, complete, and consistent.
alternative_evidence: Data governance quality dashboard reports displaying automated data integrity metrics.
verification_procedure: Inspect data entry validation rules (e.g., regex checks, checksum validation).
Verify automated deduplication routines across disparate database repositories.
Confirm that data corrections submitted by Data Principals synchronize across all operational stores.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Absence of schema validation leading to truncated or corrupted customer profiles violates Section 8(3).
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Sanitize database field names containing internal secrets; use synthetic record samples.
retention_considerations: Active document.
reviewer_guidance: Check whether data shared with third-party processors is updated upon principal correction.

title: Breach Escalation & Triage Protocol
description: Operational SOP defining specific technical criteria, severity matrices, and rapid escalation protocols for potential personal data breaches.
acceptable_examples: SOC tier-1 to tier-3 escalation playbooks
alternative_evidence: PagerDuty/Opsgenie incident escalation policies configured for data privacy security triggers.
verification_procedure: Verify criteria distinguishing privacy incidents from routine infrastructure alerts.
Check automated alerting mechanisms to the Data Protection Officer and Legal Counsel.
Confirm timeline milestones designed to achieve regulatory intimations without undue delay.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Escalation paths requiring multi-layer bureaucratic approvals before security notification commences violate statutory urgency.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Mask personal contact numbers; retain operational role titles.
retention_considerations: Active operational procedure.
reviewer_guidance: Review tabletop exercise records to verify protocol execution fidelity.

title: DSAR Fulfillment & Identity Verification SOP
description: Step-by-step operating procedure for intake, identity verification, scope determination, data retrieval, redaction, and transmission of Data Principal rights responses.
acceptable_examples: Identity verification decision matrix (knowledge-based, OTP, existing session)
alternative_evidence: Privacy management platform workflow diagram and configuration manual.
verification_procedure: Confirm that identity verification requires only proportionate information necessary to authenticate the applicant.
Verify third-party redaction steps ensuring one applicant does not receive another person's personal data.
Confirm documentation of grounds and communication workflows when a request is refused.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Demanding notarized affidavits or physical document submission for online digital users creates an impermissible barrier.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Blank templates and sanitized process flows only.
retention_considerations: Active operational procedure.
reviewer_guidance: Test whether the procedure addresses requests submitted on behalf of deceased or incapacitated principals by lawful nominees under Section 14.

title: Grievance Redressal Ticketing SLA & Escalation
description: Standard operating procedure governing receipt, investigation, resolution, and escalation of complaints submitted under Section 13.
acceptable_examples: Ticketing workflow with automated SLA timers
alternative_evidence: CRM customer support ticketing system SLA configuration and reporting metrics.
verification_procedure: Verify maximum turnaround time aligns with statutory requirements (prescribed period under Rule 14).
Confirm inclusion of mandatory statutory advisory informing complainant of their right to escalate unresolved grievances to the DPBI.
Verify independent review capability for contested complaints.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Routing privacy complaints to general sales or unmonitored general email queues without tracking or statutory advisory fails Section 13.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Template workflows and anonymized aggregate SLA metrics only.
retention_considerations: Retain dispute logs for 3 years following resolution.
reviewer_guidance: Scrutinize whether resolved complaint notifications clearly inform the Data Principal of their right to appeal to the Board.

title: Verifiable Parental Consent Architecture Flow
description: Architectural documentation, flowcharts, and live screenshots demonstrating verified parental or guardian consent before processing children's data.
acceptable_examples: Integration documentation with approved parental verification methods (e.g. DigiLocker parental relationship tokenization, dual-factor parent OTP)
alternative_evidence: Third-party age assurance provider certification (e.g., Yoti, Veratad) integrated into onboarding.
verification_procedure: Inspect the age-gating mechanism to confirm it cannot be bypassed by merely refreshing the page.
Verify that consent request is routed to a verifiable parent/guardian before child account activation.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Relying on an unverified self-declaration checkbox ('I am 18 or older') without technical verification fails Section 9(1).
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Use synthetic minor and parent test accounts exclusively. Zero real children's data.
retention_considerations: Retain parental verification tokens for the life of the child account.
reviewer_guidance: Scrutinize the age-gating logic for vulnerabilities and dark patterns.

title: Child Tracking Suppression Technical Proof
description: Technical architectural specifications, code inspection records, and ad-tech configuration proofs demonstrating suppression of tracking, behavioural profiling, and targeted ads for minor accounts.
acceptable_examples: Ad-server configuration files disabling retargeting pixel injection for accounts flagged as minors
SDK initialization logs suppressing analytics tracking
Database feature flags disabling recommendation algorithms for minor user segments
alternative_evidence: Independent ad-tech audit report certifying zero behavioural tracking on minor account tiers.
verification_procedure: Inspect frontend source code and network requests for minor accounts to verify absence of third-party tracking pixels.
Verify ad server bidding request payloads confirm omission of behavioural segments.
Inspect recommendation engine algorithms to ensure purely contextual, non-profiling logic.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Disabling ads on mobile apps while continuing behavioural tracking on web platforms violates Section 9(3).
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Sanitize API keys and internal microservice endpoint URLs.
retention_considerations: Architecture baselines maintained per release.
reviewer_guidance: Conduct dynamic traffic inspection using developer tools on synthetic minor user profiles.

title: DPO Appointment Resolution & Reporting Charter
description: Certified copy of the Board of Directors resolution formally appointing an India-resident Data Protection Officer, accompanied by the DPO Governance Charter.
acceptable_examples: Extract of Board Meeting Minutes signed by Company Secretary
DPO Job Charter establishing independent reporting to the Board
Proof of India residency (e.g. resident employment contract extract)
alternative_evidence: Executive appointment letter signed by CEO and Board Chairman.
verification_procedure: Verify that the appointed DPO is resident in India.
Confirm reporting hierarchy connects directly to the Board or governing body, not mid-level IT management.
Verify that the DPO is empowered with independent authority and access to all processing streams.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Naming an overseas executive or assigning DPO duties to a marketing lead with conflicting business targets violates Section 10(2)(a).
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Redact remuneration and personal compensation terms.
retention_considerations: Retain for the duration of the appointment plus 5 years.
reviewer_guidance: Verify that contact details of the DPO match those published in the public privacy notice under Section 8(8).

title: DPIA Methodology & Completed Assessments
description: Formal DPIA framework methodology, assessment questionnaires, risk scoring rubrics, and copies of completed DPIA reports for high-risk processing activities.
acceptable_examples: Completed DPIA reports for major automated processing, AI deployment, or biometrics initiatives
alternative_evidence: ISO/IEC 27701 privacy risk assessments paired with executive DPIA summary.
verification_procedure: Confirm DPIA assesses necessity, proportionality, data principal harm, and mitigation measures.
Verify involvement and formal sign-off of the Data Protection Officer.
Inspect implementation tracking of mitigation actions identified during the DPIA.
limitations_and_weaknesses: High-level checklists completed in minutes without technical architecture analysis or risk evaluation fail statutory DPIA requirements.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Redact trade secrets or unannounced proprietary product features; retain privacy impact analysis and risk ratings.
retention_considerations: Retain for the lifespan of the processing activity plus 5 years.
reviewer_guidance: Evaluate whether DPIAs are initiated during design phases (Privacy by Design) or only retrospectively.

title: Cross-Border Data Transfer Inventory
description: Comprehensive technical register detailing all outbound transfers of personal data outside India, including destination countries, transfer mechanisms, cloud hosting regions, and third-party recipients.
acceptable_examples: Cloud region configuration reports (e.g., AWS global infrastructure inventory)
alternative_evidence: Enterprise data flow diagrams explicitly labelling geographic boundaries and transit routes.
verification_procedure: Match destination countries against Central Government notified negative list / restricted jurisdictions.
Verify that transfers comply with applicable bilateral or sectoral transfer restrictions.
Confirm that contractually bound foreign sub-processors adhere to DPDPA equivalent safeguards.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Assuming data stays in India without verifying actual backup, CDN cache, or analytics processing locations fails this control.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Sanitize internal server IPs and subnets; preserve country names and cloud regions.
retention_considerations: Active document.
reviewer_guidance: Check where database backups, analytics logs, and customer support portal data reside.

title: Sectoral Data Localization System Audit Report
description: Formal compliance audit report or regulatory filing attesting to strict domestic data localization mandated by sector-specific regulators (e.g., RBI payment system data directive, IRDAI insurance guidelines).
acceptable_examples: CERT-In empaneled System Audit Report (SAR) on RBI Storage of Payment System Data
alternative_evidence: Internal audit report signed by Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and statutory auditors verifying domestic storage.
verification_procedure: Confirm end-to-end data processing and storage resides strictly on servers physically located in India.
Verify that cross-border processing for fraud detection or settlement adheres strictly to sectoral turnaround and deletion windows.
Inspect auditor opinion and attestation signature blocks.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Claiming DPDPA Section 16 allows unrestricted transfers while ignoring strict RBI/IRDAI domestic storage mandates is legally invalid.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Redact commercial audit fee figures. Retain audit scope, findings, and auditor attestation.
retention_considerations: Retain for statutory regulatory retention period (minimum 5 years).
reviewer_guidance: Cross-check with sectoral regulatory requirements applicable to the client's industry.

title: Enterprise Statutory Penalty Deficit Exposure Risk
description: Executive-level risk exposure register quantifying organizational financial liability across the five Schedule penalty brackets based on identified compliance gaps.
acceptable_examples: TLI Gap Analysis Report executive briefing
alternative_evidence: Chief Risk Officer (CRO) quarterly regulatory liability assessment memo.
verification_procedure: Verify quantification of maximum exposure across statutory penalty brackets (₹250 Cr, ₹200 Cr, ₹150 Cr, ₹50 Cr, ₹10,000).
Confirm linkage between unmitigated operational deficits and statutory exposure tiers.
Verify reporting to Board Audit Committee or Chief Executive Officer.
limitations_and_weaknesses: Highlighting operational risks without quantifying statutory financial liability fails to drive board-level remediation.
masking_and_redaction_requirements: Redact unapproved future budget allocations. Retain risk scores and exposure figures.
retention_considerations: Retain for 3 years.
reviewer_guidance: Cross-reference the exposure model with the output of the TLI Provisional Scoring and Risk Engine.
